theorem eventually_smoothPair_uniformWidth_prime_sub_vonMangoldt_logAccuracy
    (J : ℕ) {b κ widthMax a K Cρ θ : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hgap : 2 * widthMax ≤ P4BOuterRampRoughness.baseline b κ - a)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hCρ : 0 < Cρ) (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1)
    (A ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ width : ℝ, 0 < width → width ≤ widthMax →
      ∀ Q : Finset ℕ, ∀ ρ : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ χ : ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ q ∈ Q, 0 < q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ K * (N : ℝ) ^ θ) →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, |ρ q| ≤ Cρ * (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J) →
      (∀ s ≤ 1, χ s = 1) → (∀ s ≥ 2, χ s = 0) →
      (∀ s, χ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ‖(primeProductSignedError 2 N N Q ρ
          (smoothPhysicalPairOuterRamp b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff κ N) width) : ℂ) -
        finiteProductSignedError (Icc 1 (Nat.ceil (Real.exp widthMax * (N : ℝ)))) Q N
          (fun q => (ρ q : ℂ))
          (labelledVonMangoldtProductMass 2 N
            (smoothPhysicalPairOuterRamp b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff κ N) width))‖ ≤
        ε * (N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ) ^ A

    (A ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (width : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hwidth : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, 0 < width N ∧ width N ≤ widthMax) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ Q : Finset ℕ, ∀ ρ : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ χ : ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ q ∈ Q, 0 < q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ K * (N : ℝ) ^ θ) →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, |ρ q| ≤ Cρ * (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J) →
      (∀ s ≤ 1, χ s = 1) → (∀ s ≥ 2, χ s = 0) →
      (∀ s, χ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ‖(primeProductSignedError 2 N N Q ρ
          (smoothPhysicalPairOuterRamp b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff κ N)
            (width N)) : ℂ) -
        finiteProductSignedError (Icc 1 (Nat.ceil (Real.exp widthMax * (N : ℝ)))) Q N

          (labelledVonMangoldtProductMass 2 N
            (smoothPhysicalPairOuterRamp b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff κ N)

        ε * (N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ) ^ A

remaining_exact_propositions.uniform_auxiliary_SW:
def UniformAuxiliarySW {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom) (C0 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
    ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale → ∀ k q b : ℕ,
      1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ q → Nat.Coprime b q →
      ‖(F i).auxSWError k q b‖ ≤
        C * (F i).U * ((k.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) /
          (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A
remaining_exact_propositions.restricted_medium_obligation:
def RestrictedMediumObligation {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom)
    (B C0 : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < σ → σ < 1 / 100 → 0 < c0 → 0 ≤ κ → κ ≤ σ / 100 →
  (∀ i : ι, MediumAdmissible B σ κ c0 (F i)) →
  UniformAuxiliarySW F C0 → RestrictedMediumTarget F
remaining_exact_propositions.uniform_prime_product_target:
def UniformPrimeProductTarget {ι : Type*} (k : ℕ) (cap : ℕ → ℕ)
    (Q : ℕ → Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (W : (N : ℕ) → ι → (Fin k → Fin (cap N + 1)) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
    ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N → Even N → ∀ i : ι,
      |primeProductSignedError k (cap N) N (Q N) (rho N) (W N i)| ≤
        C * (N : ℝ) / (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ A
